hotels.title: Five-Star Adults-Only Fiji Beachside Retreat on Tokoriki Island
hotels.description: Laidback luxury on Fiji’s phenomenal sands awaits with an escape to the adults-only, five-star Tokoriki Island Resort. This award-winning resort offers just 36 traditional bures and villas surrounded by lush greenery, and each one offers a taste of secluded serenity while perfectly fusing modern Fijian-inspired design elements. Savour Fijian fine dining and watch swaying palm trees move with the salty sea breeze, rejuvenate and revitalise with a visit to the world-class Tokoriki Spa or take it easy and watch the day drift slowly by with a cocktail in hand. Whatever you decide, you'll be supported by Tokoriki Island Resort's traditional Fijian hospitality and top-notch attention to detail.

hotels.title: Award-Winning Fiji Adults-Only Island Paradise with All-Inclusive Dining & Nightly Free-Flow Cocktail Hour
hotels.description: Behold the benchmark for boutique luxury in Fiji - complete with many accolades. Voted the South Pacific’s #1 resort in the Travel + Leisure World’s Best Awards 2026 for the second consecutive year, this intimate adults-only hideaway has earned its reputation through something far more enduring than good looks: the kind of unhurried Fijian hospitality that stays with you long after checkout. With a maximum guest count of 72, Tokoriki is deliberately, beautifully intimate. There are no crowds here, no queues for sunbeds - just powdery white sand, the ocean’s gentle rhythm and a team that always keeps you front of mind. Surround yourself with traditional Fijian design, personal pools, lush tropical gardens and unique outdoor showers that make each morning routine a ritual. Daily a la carte breakfast arrives with free-flow French sparkling wine, while happy hour brings canapes and cocktails (according to resort schedule) as the sun dips beneath the horizon. A highlight of your stay is an evening at Oishii Teppanyaki - a theatrical dining experience that’s as much a spectacle as it is a meal.
